title: `Command(update=...)` applies an overridden inherited state field twice
observed_behavior: A dataclass subclass re-declares an inherited Annotated[int, operator.add] field. Returning State(count=2) directly with input count=1 yields 3; returning Command(update=State(count=2)) applies the field twice and yields 5. With a non-reducer field the same path raises InvalidUpdateError.
structure_focus: Command(update=...) vs plain dict update on an inherited field with duplicated annotations in the class MRO
notes: Open, label external. Single-node graph with dataclass state; the graph shape is trivial and the reported defect is in Command.update field collection. comments trace it to get_cached_annotated_keys walking the full MRO and appending inherited annotations twice; a PR (#9012) is proposed. The fixture keeps the two-path comparison because that contrast is the observed behavior.
